text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0 (effective 2026-01-01), an Overdraft Transfer Protection transfer from a linked Primary Share (savings) Account costs $5.00 per transfer, with only one transfer fee charged per business day no matter how many items the transfer covers.","cited_chunk_ids":["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Overdraft Policy v3 section 4 explicitly states the $5.00 per-transfer fee for Overdraft Transfer Protection from savings, capped at one per business day."}
